_note: RegionDINO object-only (18 views per image on brightness-rule regions, no whole-image view) on the FAIR-CSAR pool 'fair_tiles': native 2 x 2 512-px tiles of the trainval slices (1 m per pixel). object_views / dino / optim sections equal RegionSSL/RegionDINO_object/config_ssl.json; regions from RegionSSL/make_regions.py --pool fair_tiles. 500-epoch CONTROL for the gradient-region run: random windows whose sizes are drawn from the GRADIENT region file (regions_dir), random places.

overrides._note: 500 epochs x 297 steps = 148,500 optimizer steps, the SARDet-100K pool's count (147k); the 100-epoch runs stopped at 29,700

object_views._note: windows are sized from each region's own extent (no fixed pixel size); max_magnification stops tiny blobs being blown up; region_source random = the control with matched-size random windows
